What is a cascading failure?

FinBot processes each invoice through a chain of specialised agents: Invoice → Fraud → Payments → Communication. Each agent trusts the output of the previous one, so an error or a plausible-but-flawed judgement early in the chain can amplify as it propagates downstream — a cascading failure. Pick a scenario below to watch one unfold live against the real agent chain.
